teach_en: Like the k in 'sky': a k with no puff of air.
notes: From letters.csv C01 (ipa k: unaspirated; verified); wording by agent. Changed 2026-11-09 from 'a hard g' so the text reads correctly in both transliteration styles (user).

teach_en: As in the word 'no'.
notes: From letters.csv C13 (ipa_initial = ipa_final n; verified); wording by agent. Taught with C13f as one card (same-sound pair; user 2026-10-24).

teach_en: At the end of a syllable, as in the word 'sun'.
notes: From letters.csv C13 (ipa_final n; verified); wording by agent. Shortened 2026-10-24.

teach_en: A short 'ee', shorter than the ee in 'been'. Written above the consonant, but said after it.
notes: From vowels.csv V04 pron_tip (verified); wording by agent. Shortened 2026-10-24. A4 2026-11-13: hint revised, owner + formant check. L1b 2026-11-13: one-unit / consonant-first line added (owner play-test). Owner 2026-11-13: consonant-first line moved to the R03 lead-in card; unit card keeps a short reminder. Owner 2026-11-13: card text trimmed (one point per sentence; one-unit principle on R03 only).

teach_en: A k with a puff of air, as in the word 'kite'.
notes: From letters.csv C02 pron_tip (verified); wording by agent.

teach_en: A small mark written above the letter. It changes the melody of the word.
notes: From letters.csv T2 (verified: the mark changes the tone); wording by agent. The class rule is deliberately left out (user 2026-11-09).

teach_en: As in the word 'now'. Written in three parts around the consonant, but said after it.
notes: From vowels.csv V35 pron_tip and pattern ເ◌ົາ (verified); wording by agent. L1b 2026-11-13: one-unit / consonant-first line added (owner play-test). Owner 2026-11-13: consonant-first line moved to the R03 lead-in card; unit card keeps a short reminder. Owner 2026-11-13: card text trimmed (one point per sentence; one-unit principle on R03 only).

teach_en: Like the l in 'law'.
notes: From letters.csv C23 pron_tip (verified: l as in 'law'); wording by agent.

teach_en: At the end of a syllable, a short w sound, as at the end of 'now'.
notes: From letters.csv C24 pron_tip (verified: at the end of a syllable a w glide as in 'now'); wording by agent.

teach_en: Like the a in 'father'. Written after the consonant.
notes: From vowels.csv V03 pron_tip (verified: long 'a' as in 'father') and its pattern; wording by agent. L1b 2026-11-13: one-unit / consonant-first line added (owner play-test). Owner 2026-11-13: consonant-first line moved to the R03 lead-in card; unit card keeps a short reminder.

teach_en: Like the o in 'Tom' (American), said short. A small circle above the consonant and a stroke after it. Both parts are one vowel, said after the consonant.
notes: From vowels.csv row V36 pron_tip (verified: 'um' as in 'hum') and its pattern; wording by agent. A4 2026-11-13: hint revised, owner + formant check. L1b 2026-11-13: one-unit / consonant-first line added (owner play-test). Owner 2026-11-13: card text trimmed (one point per sentence; one-unit principle on R03 only).

teach_en: Like the e in 'bed', held long (like 'air' without the r). Wide open: not the 'ay' of 'say'. Written before the consonant, but said after it. It looks like two ເ side by side, but it is one vowel.
notes: From vowels.csv V15 pron_tip (verified: long 'a' as in 'cat') and pattern ແ◌; the look-alike remark is about the written shape only; wording by agent. A4 2026-11-13: hint revised, owner + formant check. L1b 2026-11-13: one-unit / consonant-first line added (owner play-test).

teach_en: Like the b in 'boy'.
notes: From letters.csv C14 pron_tip (verified: b as in 'boy'). Initial role only; its final sound (an unreleased p) is a later unit, so it is not mentioned. Wording by agent.

teach_en: A second tone mark, a small stroke above the letter. Words with this mark are said at a flat, middle pitch.
notes: From letters.csv T1 (verified: gives the mid tone for every class); 'flat, middle pitch' restates the mid tone without naming classes (decision 11). Wording by agent.

teach_en: Like 'aw' with rounded lips, halfway to 'oh'. A small circle above the consonant, with no stroke after it.
notes: From vowels.csv V21 pron_tip (verified: long 'aw' as in 'law') and its pattern ◌ໍ; the 'no stroke after it' remark separates it from ◌ຳ (lesson 4) by its written shape only; wording by agent. A4 2026-11-13: hint revised, owner + formant check. L1b 2026-11-13: one-unit / consonant-first line added (owner play-test). Owner 2026-11-13: consonant-first line moved to the R03 lead-in card; unit card keeps a short reminder. Owner 2026-11-13: card text trimmed (one point per sentence; one-unit principle on R03 only).

teach_en: Like the d in 'deck'.
notes: From letters.csv C09 pron_tip (verified: d as in 'deck'). Initial role only; its final sound (an unreleased t) is a later unit, so it is not mentioned. Wording by agent.

teach_en: Like the ee in 'see'. Written above the consonant. It looks like ◌ິ with one more stroke.
notes: From vowels.csv V05 pron_tip (verified: 'ee' as in 'see') and its pattern ◌ີ; the comparison with V04 ◌ິ is about the written shape only; wording by agent; no length wording on the card front (review) L1b 2026-11-13: one-unit / consonant-first line added (owner play-test). Owner 2026-11-13: consonant-first line moved to the R03 lead-in card; unit card keeps a short reminder. Owner 2026-11-13: card text trimmed (one point per sentence; one-unit principle on R03 only).

teach_en: Like the s in 'saw'.
notes: From letters.csv C06 pron_tip (verified: s as in 'saw'); the same-sound letter ຊ is not taught yet so it is not mentioned. Wording by agent.

teach_en: At the end of a syllable, a short y sound, roughly like the y at the end of 'bye'.
notes: From letters.csv C08 pron_tip (verified: at the end of a syllable a y glide); 'bye' from the ສະບາຍດີ pron_tip in words.csv. Final role only; the initial ny sound is a later unit. Modelled on the C24f card. Wording by agent.

teach_en: A short 'a', like the 'uh' in 'uh-oh'. Written after the consonant.
notes: From vowels.csv V01 pron_tip (verified: short 'a' cut off sharply as in 'uh-oh') and its pattern ◌ະ; the cut-off itself is on the R01 card. Wording by agent. L1b 2026-11-13: one-unit / consonant-first line added (owner play-test). Owner 2026-11-13: consonant-first line moved to the R03 lead-in card; unit card keeps a short reminder. Owner 2026-11-13: card text trimmed (one point per sentence; one-unit principle on R03 only).

teach_en: The j in 'jaw'.
notes: Owner 2026-11-17: say it is the j sound (no mention of ch).

teach_en: Like the h in 'hang'.
notes: From letters.csv C25 pron_tip (verified: h as in 'hang'). Initial h role only; its silent role before ງ ຍ ນ ມ ລ ວ is a later unit, so it is not mentioned (owner: no ຫນ/ຫມ/ຫລ here). Wording by agent.

teach_en: Like 'aw' with rounded lips, halfway to 'oh'. The same sound as the circle vowel in ບໍ່, written as ອ in the middle of a syllable, as in ຂ້ອຍ. Say the first consonant, then the vowel, then the last letter.
notes: From vowels.csv V22 pron_tip (verified: 'aw' as in 'law', before a final consonant) and its pattern ◌ອ◌; V21 ◌ໍ (in ບໍ່) has the same sound group (ɔɔ) in its open form. No length wording on the card front. Wording by curriculum review. A4 2026-11-13: hint revised, owner + formant check. L1b 2026-11-13: one-unit / consonant-first line added (owner play-test). Owner 2026-11-13: card text trimmed (one point per sentence; one-unit principle on R03 only).

teach_en: Like the m in 'man'.
notes: From letters.csv C20 pron_tip (verified: m as in 'man'); wording by agent. Initial role; shown with the final role as one card.

teach_en: At the end of a syllable ມ is also m, as in 'ham'.
notes: From letters.csv C20 (ipa_final m; verified); wording by agent. Review 2026-11-14: taught with C20 (same-sound pair); only the bonus word ສ້ອມ uses it this lesson.

teach_en: At the start of a syllable ອ has no sound: it only holds the vowel, so ອາ is just 'aa'. (In the middle of a syllable, as in ຂ້ອຍ, ອ is the 'aw' vowel you already know.)
notes: From letters.csv C26 pron_tip (verified: silent carrier for a vowel at the start of a syllable). The glottal catch is left off the card front (it is in More). The second sentence is the recap of ອ's two jobs (LESSON_RULES decision 18) next to V22 from lesson 10. Wording by agent.

teach_en: Like the h in 'hang': the same sound as ຫ. Words with ຮ often have a different melody, so learn the melody with each word.
notes: From letters.csv C27 pron_tip (verified: h as in 'hang'; same sound as ຫ). CURRICULUM_PATH: 'another h' with each word's melody, no class rule (decision 11). Wording by agent.

teach_en: Like the p in 'spy': no puff of air, so to English ears it can sound like a b. Not the same as ບ (the b in 'boy').
notes: From letters.csv C15 pron_tip (verified: unaspirated p, as in 'spy') and SOUND_HINTS C15 (the ບ contrast). Wording by agent.

teach_en: Like 'ai' in 'Thai' (or 'eye'). It is written before the consonant but said after it, like ເ◌ and ແ◌.
notes: From vowels.csv V33 pron_tip (verified: 'ai' as in 'Thai'); SOUND_HINTS V33 keep (or 'eye'). R03 (written first, said second) is known since the ເ◌ົາ / ແ◌ lessons. Wording by agent.

teach_en: At the end of a syllable ບ is a p with the lips closed and no puff, like the p in 'top man' said fast. The syllable stops short there.
notes: From letters.csv C14 (verified: final p̚, unreleased) pron_tip. The stop is the cut-off syllable (R01, lesson 8), named in plain words (decision 25). Wording by agent.

teach_en: The same 'ai' as ໄ◌ (in ໄປ), just a different shape, also written before the consonant. Which of the two a word uses is part of its spelling.
notes: From vowels.csv V34 (verified: 'ai' as in 'Thai'; same sound as ໄ◌ in Vientiane). One card naming both shapes (CURRICULUM_PATH lesson 16; decision 18). Wording by agent.

teach_en: Like the y in 'young'.
notes: From letters.csv C21 pron_tip (verified: y as in 'young'); SOUND_HINTS C21 keep. Wording by agent.

teach_en: A long 'oo' as in 'food', with the lips well rounded and pushed forward. It is written under the consonant.
notes: From vowels.csv V09 pron_tip (verified: long 'oo' as in 'food') and SOUND_HINTS V09 (lips rounded and pushed forward). Wording by agent.

teach_en: Like the 'ng' in 'singer', but in Lao it can also start a word, as in ງາມ (beautiful). At the end of a syllable, as in ຫ້ອງ, it is the ng of 'song'.
notes: From letters.csv C04 pron_tip (verified: 'ng' of 'singer', can start a word; ipa_initial = ipa_final ŋ). One card for both positions (decision 10). SOUND_HINTS C04 keep. Wording by agent.

teach_en: At the end of a syllable ງ is the ng of 'song'.
notes: From letters.csv C04 (ipa_final ŋ; verified). Shown with C04 as one card (same-sound pair, like C13/C13f and C20/C20f). Wording by agent.

teach_en: The same m sound as ມ, written as one letter (ຫ joined to ມ). Words with ໝ often have a different melody, so learn it with each word.
notes: From letters.csv C31 pron_tip (verified: same sound as ມ; also written ຫມ). Class not named (decision 11); the melody cue follows lesson 14's ຮ card. Wording by agent.

teach_en: A pure 'oh' with tight, rounded lips, held steady, with no slide to 'oo'. Rounder and closer than the 'aw' of ບໍ່.
notes: From vowels.csv V18 pron_tip (verified: long 'o', without the glide) and SOUND_HINTS V18 (pure 'oh', no slide; not ◌ໍ). An English 'go' glides, so it is not the cue (curriculum review 2026-11-19). Wording by agent.
